title: k8s-mcp-server: Missing authentication on default SSE/HTTP transport allows unauthenticated Kubernetes tool execution…
description: k8s-mcp-server versions prior to 1.1.0 running in default SSE transport mode expose an unauthenticated HTTP endpoint on port 8080 bound to all interfaces. This endpoint allows any network-accessible client to enumerate and invoke Kubernetes tools, including destructive operations, without authentication. The server does not enforce authorization or origin checks, and the default configuration permits state-changing commands. This vulnerability is due to missing authentication on critical functions and is classified as CWE-306.
